title: PointCLIP: Point Cloud Understanding by CLIP
grouping: Mirror-symmetric layout around a shared centre: the proposed route on the left (2D Image-Text Pairs -> Train -> PointCLIP), the classic route on the right (3D Training Set, inside a light-grey rounded panel -> Train -> PointNet++), and between them the shared 3D Test Set point cloud with a small prediction bar chart below. Both models send a Test arrow up to the shared test sample.
shapes_depth: Data is shown as data: three small photos (chair, lamp, airplane) beside a 3 x 3 image-text matching grid with green-tinted diagonal cells and italic grey caption texts as column heads; coloured point clouds (orange lamp, red chair, blue airplane) for the 3D sets. The two models are flat rounded boxes - PointCLIP pale yellow, PointNet++ light grey. The prediction is a tiny three-bar chart in pastel red, blue and yellow with rotated class labels. Thin black arrows with italic serif labels (Train, Test); serif titles.
proposed_highlight: The method box is the only warm fill (yellow) against the baseline's grey; the symmetric layout makes the training data the single visible difference.
lesson: Mirror the proposed and the classic pipeline around one shared test sample in the centre - method box tinted, baseline box grey - so the only asymmetry the reader sees is what each model was trained on.
notes: Venue CVPR from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2112.02413). elements 'other' = point-cloud renderings. Not a PointNet redraw: the baseline named is PointNet++ and it is shown only as a labelled box. The photos and point-cloud renderings are embedded rasters; measured photo_share counts them. Annotation note (2026-11-15): concept/teaser comparison figure (PointCLIP vs PointNet++ training data), not the method architecture

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: zero-shot point cloud classification via CLIP

insights.structure: Mirror-symmetric comparison: left column '2D Image-Text Pairs' (photo x caption grid with green diagonal) trains PointCLIP, right column '3D Training Set' (rounded panel of point clouds) trains PointNet++, and both 'Test' arrows converge on a shared center '3D Test Set' airplane and a bar chart.
insights.data: Image-text pairs are drawn as three real product photos against three italic captions forming a 3x3 matrix with green matched diagonal; point clouds are colored dot renders; the prediction is a three-bar chart labeled chair/plane/lamp.
insights.emphasis: The proposed PointCLIP is a yellow rounded box versus the baseline PointNet++ in grey, and its training source (2D pairs, no 3D data) is the point of contrast.
insights.flow: Top-down within each side (data -> Train -> model), then diagonal 'Test' arrows inward to the center test set and down to the class scores.
insights.avoid: This is a concept teaser, not a pipeline: PointCLIP's internal projection and encoders are absent, so it cannot serve as an architecture skeleton.

arrangement.units: two mirrored unframed columns (left 2D pairs, right 3D training set in a rounded grey-outline panel) with a shared center column
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos with quoted captions (left), point-cloud renders (right)
arrangement.shared: center 3D test set and class-score chart used by both sides
